metadata_note: Evidence-range validation revision of the five Sol CUDA cases. Oversized line ranges were mechanically split into contiguous spans of at most 500 lines. r5 adds the distinct packed-kernel timed dispatch/backedge proof. Original proposal preserved at spmv-luna-sol-cuda-proposal.json. No program execution or compilation.

reviews.summary: The benchmark selects a subwarp/warp specialization from average entries per row, with a separate unrolled full-warp path for very long rows, then invokes the chosen launcher once per timed iteration. Native host assembly retains the counter/backedge around the indirect launcher call. The emitted SASS specializations for both uint16 and uint32 indices retain CSR delimiter/value/vector reads, multiply-accumulation, entry-loop branches, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: Kernel maps rows and lanes, reads CSR delimiters and every lane-strided entry, accumulates products, reduces lanes, and writes the row result. Dispatch covers 1/2/4/8/16/32 lanes and unrolled 32-lane long rows; the timed iteration loop calls the selected launch each time, and -i is parsed.

compiled_evidence.claim: Both uint16 and uint32 benchmark paths record the timed start, call the selected launcher in a counter-controlled loop, increment/compare the iteration count and branch back, then record the stop. Emitted launcher specializations cover the dispatch choices.

All emitted uint32 and uint16 lane/unroll specializations contain CSR-related loads, double multiply-accumulation (including unrolled or lane-strided paths), conditional entry-loop backedges, and global output stores; no dispatch-relevant specialization is represented only by an empty stub.

reviews.notes: Input/output overwrite is expected for repeated y=A*x. No CUDA execution or timing reduction assessment was performed.

reviews.summary: Average row length selects one of six lane-group launchers. The native launcher wrappers retain the requested iteration counter/backedge around each CUDA kernel launch. Every emitted lane specialization performs CSR-indexed value/vector work, double multiply-accumulation, loop control, and a row output store.

source_evidence.claim: The device kernel loads row offsets and traverses lane-strided entries, accumulates and writes lane zero's row result; launchSpmv loops over iterations and dispatch chooses among 1/2/4/8/16/32 lanes from average row length.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled launchSpmv specializations include a counter-driven launch loop with cudaLaunchKernel and a backedge; the runSpmv timed path records events and dispatches the selected launcher between them.

The six emitted lane-group kernel variants contain row-boundary and value/vector global loads, DFMA work on nonzero entries, conditional traversal backedges and global result stores, including the one-lane case.

reviews.notes: The warm-up call is outside timed event interval; repeated output overwrite is intended. No runtime was executed.

reviews.summary: Dispatch selects either the warp-per-row CSR path or sorted/padded sliced-row path. Both native timed callers retain the iteration counter/backedge around their actual kernel stub. Both emitted device kernels show their respective row/nonzero traversal, loads, arithmetic and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: The sliced and warp kernels each process CSR entries and write the original row's output; timeSpmv repeats launches for iterations. Source selects warp for small matrices and sliced otherwise, with work-size and row mappings established by preparation code.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled runWarp and runSliced timed paths record start, increment/compare iteration counters, call the corresponding device stub each iteration, branch back, and record stop; the zero-iteration branch exits without launches.

The emitted warp and sliced kernels both load row metadata and CSR value/vector operands, perform double multiply and accumulation, retain traversal/tile branches, and store row outputs; these are the two dispatch alternatives.

reviews.notes: Repeated output overwrite is intended. Static dispatch and native/device code inspected; no runtime execution.

reviews.summary: Average entries per row and row count select 1/4/8/16/32 lanes. The emitted timed path keeps a native iteration counter around calls to the selected kernel launcher. Each compiled lane variant retains CSR loads, double multiply-accumulation, traversal backedges, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: Kernel maps lane groups to rows, traverses every lane-strided CSR entry, reduces and stores the row result. Dispatch covers 1/4/8/16/32 lanes; the timed loop invokes the selected launch once for every requested iteration.

compiled_evidence.claim: Native spmvCuda records the timed start, calls the selected launcher inside an increment/compare/backedge iteration loop, and records stop; emitted launcher wrappers reach cudaLaunchKernel.

All five emitted lane variants contain row/delimiter and matrix/vector loads, DFMA arithmetic, conditional nonzero traversal branches, and global output stores; specialization differences do not remove the CSR work.

reviews.notes: Warm-up is separate from timed iterations and output overwrite is intended. No CUDA runtime was executed.

reviews.summary: The timed caller launches either the packed-row kernel (including its separate long-row blocks) or regular CSR kernel inside the requested iteration loop; native assembly preserves the counter/backedge on both alternatives. Both emitted kernels retain the relevant row/nonzero work, arithmetic, backedges, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: CSR fallback traverses each row's delimiter interval; packed rows map back to original rows and long rows are handled in tiled blocks, with value/vector multiplication, accumulation and output stores. The timed iteration loop repeats the chosen launch; -i sets that count.

compiled_evidence.claim: The actual timed spmvGpu path records its start event and reaches the CSR alternative in its counter loop (3545-3579) or packed alternative's device stub call (3667); the packed path increments/compares the same iteration counter and branches back to packed dispatch, while the CSR path has its own counter/backedge. Both are within the timed event interval.

Packed kernel's regular and long-row paths contain indexed loads, DMUL/DADD work, long-row/tile and traversal branches, and stores; the CSR fallback separately contains indexed CSR loads, multiply-accumulation, nonzero-loop backedge, and output store.

reviews.notes: Packed path's long rows are not omitted: they occupy extra blocks and are processed in tiles. Output overwrite is expected; no runtime execution.

citation_format_normalization.method: Split ranges longer than500 lines into consecutive chunks of at most500, preserving exactly the same cited lines, order, scientific findings and prose. Raw proposals retained.
